prompts.text: I have pretended to be sick to get out of a commitment.
I have written a reply in my head and forgotten to send it.
I have forgotten someone's name while they were saying it.
I have said I was almost there while I was still at home.
I have opened the fridge three times hoping new food would appear.
I have nodded in a meeting while understanding absolutely nothing.
I have quietly hoped plans would be cancelled.
I have left a message unanswered because I did not know how to end the conversation.
I have forgotten where I parked and blamed the parking lot.
I have rehearsed a simple sentence before saying it to a boss.
I have ordered the same takeout because choosing felt like work.
I have taken free merchandise I did not actually want.
I have put an event on my calendar and still forgotten it.
I have kept a browser tab open for months because I might need it.
I have tracked a delivery even when I knew it was not arriving today.
I have practiced an argument that never happened.
Who in this room would give the most convincing alibi?
Who in this room would notice a suspicious detail first?
Who in this room would arrive late with the most believable excuse?
Who in this room would be best at keeping a harmless secret?
